title: Before you try a plan
body: A field’s cover is changing. In this game’s runoff model, what would you need to compare the old and new uses fairly?

choices.explanation: Cover matters, but area, storm and soil assumptions also shape the estimate. Keep shared conditions the same when comparing uses.

choices.text: Both covers and areas, with the same storm and soil assumptions.
choices.explanation: Yes. Hold shared conditions steady so the comparison can reveal the effect of the cover change. These assumptions still limit what it says about real land.

choices.text: The credits spent on each option.
choices.explanation: Credits show a game budget trade-off. They do not describe how rain interacts with the modeled ground.
